tools.name: offshoreproz_list_jurisdictions
tools.description: List all available company-formation jurisdictions with pricing and timelines. No sensitive data. Call this first.

tools.name: offshoreproz_get_jurisdiction_requirements
tools.description: Return the required fields to form a company in a given jurisdiction.

tools.name: offshoreproz_estimate_cost
tools.description: Estimate the all-in cost for a jurisdiction. MUST be called before create_formation; returns an estimate_token required to create.

tools.name: offshoreproz_create_formation
tools.description: Start forming a company. beneficial_owner = human custodian (authorized representative). For AI-agent formations, also pass owner_type='ai_agent' and agent_context.agent_id. Requires estimate_token from offshoreproz_estimate_cost AND user_confirmed_cost_and_process=true (user must have seen cost, ti

tools.name: offshoreproz_get_formation_status
tools.description: Get the current status and next action of a formation.

tools.name: offshoreproz_list_documents
tools.description: List documents available for a formation.

tools.name: offshoreproz_list_formations
tools.description: List all formations for the authenticated API key. Returns current status, jurisdiction, and next required actions.

tools.name: offshoreproz_cancel_formation
tools.description: Cancel a formation. Only possible from draft or pending_owner_confirmation status. Irreversible.

tools.name: offshoreproz_reissue_action_link
tools.description: Reissue an expired or lost action link for the current formation step. The old link is invalidated.

tools.name: offshoreproz_register
tools.description: Create a free test API key instantly — no portal login required. Returns op_test_* key you can use immediately in this session. For production (op_live_*), complete email OTP verification via the portal. Call this first if you have no API key yet.

tools.name: offshoreproz_get_formation_events
tools.description: Return the full audit trail / event log for a formation. Shows every status change, portal sync, webhooks, and notes. Useful for debugging or understanding where a formation is in the pipeline.

tools.name: offshoreproz_retry_formation
tools.description: Retry a formation that is in 'failed' or 'action_required' status. Resets it to pending_owner_confirmation so the owner can restart the confirmation flow.

tools.name: offshoreproz_register_webhook
tools.description: Register a webhook URL to receive real-time formation events (formation.created, formation.status_changed, formation.complete, etc.). Returns a signing secret (whsec_*) — store it to verify incoming payloads. Use '*' to receive all events.

tools.name: offshoreproz_list_webhooks
tools.description: List all registered webhook endpoints for the authenticated API key, including their event subscriptions and recent delivery stats.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "offshoreproz_register_webhook" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: offshoreproz_register_webhook · Private data: offshoreproz_list_documents, offshoreproz_list_formations, offshoreproz_register, offshoreproz_register_webhook, offshoreproz_list_webhooks · Public sink: offshoreproz_register, offshoreproz_register_webhook, offshoreproz_list_webhooks.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: offshoreproz_register_webhook · Private data: offshoreproz_list_documents, offshoreproz_list_formations, offshoreproz_register, offshoreproz_register_webhook, offshoreproz_list_webhooks · Public sink: offshoreproz_register, offshoreproz_register_webhook, offshoreproz_list_webhooks

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
